JsonLogic.title: JSON Logic Expression
JsonLogic.description: Generic JSON Logic expression. See jsonlogic.com. Not strictly validated here.

cover.description: Preferred: asset catalog id. Also accepts URI for static bundles.

balloonConfig.description: Per-character balloon style overrides (merged onto work-level defaults)

direction.description: Playback direction of this variant (schema 1.1+). `reverse` marks a pre-rendered, time-reversed encode (video only, typically without audio) used for smooth `pingpong` playback; the player falls back to frame-stepping when no `reverse` variant is available.

poster.description: Poster/preview frame shown before playback starts (schema 1.1+), e.g. for click-to-play and reduced-motion presentations.

typography.description: Global typography and styling defaults for the work

balloon_config.description: Default balloon styling for all speech bubbles in this work

videoPlayModeDefault.description: Work-level default for VideoLayer `playMode` (schema 1.1+), used when a layer does not specify its own `playMode`. Cascades work default -> per-layer override.

videoStartModeDefault.description: Work-level default for VideoLayer `startMode` (schema 1.1+), used when a layer does not specify its own `startMode`. Cascades work default -> per-layer override.

videoMutedDefault.description: Work-level default for VideoLayer `muted` (schema 1.1+), used when a layer does not specify its own `muted`. Cascades work default -> per-layer override.

sequenceAudioTracks.description: Audio tracks that span multiple panels within this chapter

background_image.description: Background image asset ID or URI

background_texture.description: Background texture asset ID or URI

transitions.description: Transition effects for entering and leaving this page

in.description: Transition effect when entering this page

out.description: Transition effect when leaving this page

canvasSize.description: Reference canvas size for CMS editor UI only (not used for player rendering)

gridHelper.description: Optional grid visual helper for CMS editor

x.description: X position (normalized: 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge)

y.description: Y position (normalized: 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge)

w.description: Width (normalized: 0-1 = 0-100% of page width, >1 allows overflow)

h.description: Height (normalized: 0-1 = 0-100% of page height, >1 allows overflow)

z.description: Z-index for overlapping panels (higher = on top)

vx.description: Visible area X position relative to panel (normalized: 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge). If omitted, full panel is visible.

vy.description: Visible area Y position relative to panel (normalized: 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge). If omitted, full panel is visible.

vw.description: Visible area width (normalized: 0-1 = 0-100% of panel width). If omitted, full panel width is visible.

vh.description: Visible area height (normalized: 0-1 = 0-100% of panel height). If omitted, full panel height is visible.

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds for autoplay. Overrides global secondsPerPanel setting for this specific panel.

visibleRect.description: Defines the visible area of the image layer. If omitted, the full layer is visible. Hidden areas are rendered at reduced opacity in the editor.

autoplay.description: Legacy field (schema 1.0). Superseded by `startMode`. If `startMode` is absent: `autoplay: true` is interpreted as `startMode: "on-view"`; explicit `autoplay: false` is interpreted as `startMode: "on-click"`. Ignored when `startMode` is present.

loop.description: Legacy field (schema 1.0). Superseded by `playMode`. If `playMode` is absent, `loop: true` is interpreted as `playMode: "loop"`. Ignored when `playMode` is present.

playMode.description: Playback mode (schema 1.1+). `once`: play through and freeze on the last frame. `loop`: play from `startAtMs` to the end, seek back, repeat. `pingpong`: play forward then backward then forward, repeating; prefers a `direction: "reverse"` VideoVariant for the backward pass, otherwise the player frame-steps backward. `loop-from`: play once from `startAtMs` to the end, then loop endlessly from `loopFromMs` to the end. Takes precedence over the legacy `loop` field when present; when absent, `loop: true` is treated as `playMode: "loop"`.

loopFromMs.description: Loop re-entry point in milliseconds, only used when `playMode` is `"loop-from"`. Absolute media time on the video's own timeline (independent of `startAtMs`). Constraint (not enforceable in JSON Schema): `startAtMs <= loopFromMs < ` the asset's `durationMs`.

startMode.description: Playback start trigger (schema 1.1+). `on-view`: starts when the panel becomes current (panel view) or when the placement enters the viewport (page view). `on-hover`: starts on mouseover; page view only, falls back to `on-click` in panel view and on touch devices. `on-click`: starts on click/tap and toggles play/pause thereafter. Takes precedence over the legacy `autoplay` field when present; when absent, `autoplay: true` is treated as `startMode: "on-view"` and explicit `autoplay: false` as `startMode: "on-click"`.

SequenceAudioTrack.description: Audio track that spans multiple panels within a chapter

id.description: Unique identifier for this audio track

format.description: Optional format filter (null = applies to all formats)

startTime.description: Start time in milliseconds relative to chapter/sequence start

shape.description: Bounding box for bubble position and size (normalized 0-1 coordinates)

balloonConfig.description: Per-bubble balloon style overrides (merged onto character or work-level defaults)

BalloonConfig.title: Balloon Configuration
BalloonConfig.description: Complete balloon styling configuration. Used at work level as defaults.

balloonType.description: Visual type of the balloon shape

maxWidth.description: Maximum balloon width in pixels (balloon auto-sizes to text)

strokeWidth.description: Balloon border stroke width in pixels

tail.description: Tail configuration (pointer from balloon to speaker)

hideBorder.description: Border hiding segment for layered balloon effects

BalloonConfigOverride.title: Balloon Configuration Override
BalloonConfigOverride.description: Partial balloon styling for character-level or bubble-level overrides. Only specified fields override the parent defaults.

HideBorderConfig.title: Hide Border Configuration
HideBorderConfig.description: Hide a segment of the balloon border for layered balloon effects

angle.description: Center angle of the hidden border segment in degrees (compass: 0=top, 90=right, 180=bottom, 270=left)

arc.description: Width of the hidden segment in degrees

BoundingBox.title: Bounding Box
BoundingBox.description: Axis-aligned bounding box using normalized coordinates (0-1). Used for speech bubble positioning.

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds for autoplay. Overrides global secondsPerPanel setting for this specific panel.
